summary: @servicetitan/component-usage preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute an obfuscated 727KB payload
details: The package's preinstall hook runs setup.mjs, which downloads the Bun runtime from oven-sh/bun GitHub releases into a temp directory, extracts and chmods it, and uses it to execute math_init.js — a 727 KB heavily obfuscated blob shipped in the package. math_init.js uses obfuscator.io string-array-rotation with hex-renamed identifiers and repeated `with` statements as anti-analysis; setup.mjs itself is obfuscated in the same style. The advertised purpose of the package is a component-usage metrics reporter to DataDog, which has no legitimate need for a second language runtime, an obfuscated 727 KB sibling script, or install-time execution of that script. The alternate-runtime dropper pattern (fetching Bun to execute obfuscated code outside Node's tooling) is used to evade Node-based install-time analysis and to run arbitrary code on the installer's host during `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
